title: We made a roguelite where your deck is made of bouncing balls, and things can get completely out of control! — BALLIATORS
author: doc4geo
selftext:
Hey everyone!

What if you could build crazy roguelike combos using nothing but bouncing balls?

That's basically how **BALLIATORS** was born! 😄

We're a small indie team, and we've spent almost a year making this physics-based roguelike deckbuilder.

The idea is simple: **Collect balls with unique abilities, build powerful synergies, and throw them into an arena where every collision can trigger something crazy.**

Some builds create massive chain reactions, others fill the arena with more balls, and sometimes things get completely out of hand. That's the fun part!

We're finally at the stage where we want real players to try it, experiment with builds, and hopefully discover combos we haven't even thought of.

If you're into roguelikes, deckbuilding, and finding ridiculous ways to break a game, we'd love to hear what you think!

And seriously, any feedback is welcome. We're still improving the game, and your thoughts could genuinely help shape it. ❤️
